messages:
Sophie: Quick q — planning routing policy for high-traffic weekend: if Dedicated pool is saturated + quota exceeded, do we fallback to hosted smaller model or queue? How do we reflect that in console and metrics?

Matthew: I vote fallback to hosted smaller model (gpt-small-ish) to keep latency. Queueing increases p99 dramatically. Circuit breaker criteria: sustained GPU util > 95% for 30s OR >2% 5xx rate in last 1m.

Alice: Agreed. Also need an explicit priority ordering per route and a header override. Draft route snippet:
```
route_match: /v1/generate
priority: dedicated_pool -> hosted_burst -> queued
overrides:
  headers:
    X-Redwood-Prefer-Hosted: true
circuit_breaker:
  gpu_util_pct: 95
  window_s: 30
  error_rate_pct: 2
```

Ben: Important: per-customer quota overrides must be evaluated before fallback. If a customer has dedicated-reserved=true, we should not fallback to hosted unless they explicitly allow. Add header X-Redwood-AllowFallback: yes/no.

Carla: For telemetry, we need fields: fallback_reason (capacity|quota|cb_trip), chosen_backend, fallback_chain_index, and estimated_quality_delta. Emit an event per request when fallback happens. Dashboards should show fallback rate by customer and route.

Omar: For rollouts, console UX should let SREs simulate fallback chain for a customer and preview expected cost / quality; plus canary a policy to 5% of traffic. Also add a soft-fail mode where we route but tag as degraded.

deploy-bot: policy/routing updated to staging: revision 2026.03.14-rc3

Sophie: Ok, can someone put this into an RFC/PR? I can take the console mockups. @Alice @Ben please own the policy schema and header semantics. We'll need tests for circuit-breaker thresholds and telemetry emits. :+1:

Alice: I'll open a draft PR with schema + unit tests today.

Ben: I'll add header parsing and per-customer override logic. Also will update openapi docs.

Carla: I'll add dashboard panels and log events mapping. Need sampling rules to avoid overload.

Matthew: Add e2e tests that simulate Dedicated saturation and verify fallback path and metric tags.

Sophie: Thanks team — let's sync on Monday 10am to sign off before weekend traffic.
